name: pharos-dev-synth
labeling: Synthetic dev set for tuning only. Codex wrote one behaviour question per sampled source function from its body with comments and docs removed; the function is the only label (grade 2). Dropped: 44 skipped as trivial, 3 that named an identifier, 0 in failed Codex batches. Questions follow the body, so they favour body-aware methods; confirm every change on the hand-written locked test sets.
